eval_dimensions.name: Phase 3 Per-Finding Gate
eval_dimensions.description: Every Finding surfaced in Phase 2 is its own AskUserQuestion gate with Apply/Skip/Defer options — findings are never silently applied or batched away without a decision point, per the 'Never auto-apply across strategies' anti-pattern rule.

eval_dimensions.name: Batch Option Offered for 5+ Same-Strategy Findings
eval_dimensions.description: When a single strategy produces 5 or more findings, the gate additionally offers 'Apply all in this strategy' so the user isn't forced through 5+ individual gates — but this is an added option, not a replacement for per-finding visibility.

eval_dimensions.name: No Remediation Before Gate Confirmation
eval_dimensions.description: Phase 4 remediation (Edit, delegation to plugin-maintenance/memory-maintenance, or issue_create) never executes for a finding until that finding's AskUserQuestion gate has been answered 'Apply'.

evals.name: A single finding opens AskUserQuestion with Apply/Skip/Defer
evals.description: Phase 3 must present each Finding via AskUserQuestion rather than assuming Apply and proceeding.
evals.input: Dev10x:plugin-doctor finds 1 mcp-vs-script-drift Finding referencing a stale memory entry

assertions.signal: gate1_uses_tool — AskUserQuestion is called for the single finding before any remediation
gate1_no_plain_text — no inline 'Should I fix this memory entry?' substitutes for the widget

evals.name: 5+ findings in one strategy add an 'Apply all' batch option
evals.description: When mcp-vs-script-drift (or any strategy) surfaces 5 or more findings, the presentation adds a batch option without dropping per-finding visibility.
evals.input: Dev10x:plugin-doctor finds 6 mcp-vs-script-drift Findings across different memory files

assertions.signal: batch_option_present — the AskUserQuestion options include 'Apply all in this strategy' alongside the per-finding options
findings_grouped_by_strategy — the 6 findings are grouped and each individually named in the presentation, not collapsed into a single opaque count

evals.name: No edit, delegation, or issue_create happens before the gate resolves
evals.description: Phase 4 remediation actions must not execute until the corresponding Phase 3 AskUserQuestion gate returns 'Apply' for that specific finding.
evals.input: Dev10x:plugin-doctor Phase 3 gate is open and unanswered for a finding recommending an Edit to a memory file

assertions.signal: no_edit_before_gate — no Edit tool call targets the memory file until the AskUserQuestion gate for that finding returns 'Apply'
no_issue_create_before_gate — mcp__plugin_Dev10x_cli__issue_create is not invoked for a 'Defer' remediation until the gate is answered

should_trigger: User hits repeated permission friction despite prior cleanup
Agent reaches for shell-script fallbacks instead of MCP tools across multiple memories
User wants a systemic audit of intent drift
should_not_trigger: A single permission rule needs ad-hoc debugging (use Dev10x:permission-investigator)
The issue is a one-off skill bug (file a ticket instead)
